movers.text: Gonzaga PG Javon Bennett (16.5 mpg) has a right knee sprain and will miss the Players Era 16 games, a team official said; expected out a few weeks. Xaivian Lee started vs K-State.
BYU PG Robert Wright III (30.2 mpg, lower-body muscle tightness) has missed three straight, incl. Washington and Ole Miss in Maui; called day-to-day, no word yet for Providence.
Kentucky C Malachi Moreno (27.8 mpg) is in concussion protocol after the Indiana game; Mark Pope is hopeful but has not given his status for Friday's Wichita State game.
UConn's Solo Ball (offseason wrist surgery, has not played this season) is nearing a return and expected to be a game-time decision vs Duke tonight in Las Vegas.
Texas PG Isaiah Johnson (24.2 mpg) left the Southern Indiana win after four minutes with a glute strain; Sean Miller called his status unknown for Georgetown (11/26) in San Diego.

Wisconsin.text: Wisconsin guard Jack Janicki (17.8 mpg) hurt his foot in the Murray State loss and will have season-ending surgery, Greg Gard said; Wisconsin is down to 12 available players.

Michigan State.text: Michigan State's Coen Carr (21.8 mpg, knee tendinitis) sat out the Detroit Mercy win; Tom Izzo expects him to play Arkansas on Thursday, role to be decided.
Michigan State starter Jordan Scott (23.4 mpg, right shoulder) was limited in practice early this week; Izzo expects him back for Arkansas on Thursday but has not set his minutes.

Tennessee.text: Tennessee's Jalen Haralson (20.5 mpg, right knee) missed a second straight game in the 72-64 Maryland win on 11/24; the team does not think it is long-term. No word yet for Iowa State.

Syracuse.text: Syracuse PG Garwey Dual (24.2 mpg) sprained his right ankle vs Lafayette on 11/21; still day-to-day with no word for UAlbany tonight. Ryan Moesch would start if he sits.

Louisville.text: Louisville reserve guard Isaac Ellis (13.5 mpg, ankle, hurt vs Stetson) will miss the Players Era Festival; Kelsey: "We do not expect him to play this week at all."

Illinois.text: Illinois guard Ethan Brown (25.1 mpg) broke his nose in the 11/23 Winthrop win; Brad Underwood said he would be evaluated, with no timetable given for Western Kentucky.

North Carolina.text: Starter Neo Avdalas (24 mpg, team-high 3.8 apg) fractured his left wrist vs. Georgia and had surgery; UNC says he is out about two months (announced 11/17).
